name: Netoge no Sekai de Deatta Kyonyuu Kanojo to Off Pako!
original_name: ネトゲの世界で出会った巨乳彼女とおふぱこ！
source:
The protagonist is immersed in the largest MMORPG in Japan called "A Kuu". Not going to school, he spends his days only doing quests. Then one day, suddenly he wondered. There are a lot of female avatars in the game, but how many of them are actually women?

"If you care about that so much, then why don't we meet up?"

Said the protagonist's in-game partner, a witch. Wondering what that person look like, waiting and thinking that maybe it was a man after all, the person that showed up at the meeting place turned out to be an immensely beautiful girl...!

[Translated and edited from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1198331]Getchu[/url]]
